Region Stockholm.focus: ICU and acute-care margins; the fast läkarkontakt rollout; 580 mnkr to vårdcentraler in the 2026 budget.
Karolinska tertiary-care capacity, the specialty workforce question, and vårdgaranti compliance.
Translates HSN and RS political directives into region operations. Beredskap and continuity of care.
Stewards the Janusinfo rekommendationslista. Evidence quality on new entrants; localisation of NT-rådet recommendations.
Stockholm-Gotland's voice in NT-rådet, active in its recommendations and horisontspaning.
Sets Stockholm-Gotland's clinical-care priorities on NSG Läkemedel; rare-disease infrastructure at Karolinska.

Region Skåne.focus: M-led HSN 2024-26: wait-time reduction, prevention, budget discipline.
Healthcare-system steering; LAG hjärt-kärlsjukdomar (Beyonttra/Vyndaqel-riktlinje 2025-11-13); LAG onkologi.
Skånelistan 2025 stewardship; Region Skåne Läkemedelsrådet rolling formulary updates; vårdriktlinjer pneumokocker 2026 lists Prevenar 20.
Represents Södra in NT-rådet's recommendation work.
Sets the Södra clinical-care agenda across Skåne, Blekinge, Halland and Kronoberg.

Västra Götalandsregionen.focus: Chairs Strategiska HSN; the Operativa HSN is chaired by My Alnebratt (S). VGR has no single HSN but a Strategiska and an Operativa nämnd plus five delregionala. Leading the new long-term care strategy (remiss to 2026-09-30, in effect 2028) and god och nära vård; the 2026 Regionplan adds 2.7 bn SEK to care.
In post since 2026-02-16; specialist in clinical pharmacology, formerly Örebro HSD. Pushing cross-system coordination across VGR's förvaltningar.
Regiondirektör Ann-Charlotte Järnström; Ulrika Strandroth Frid succeeds her on 2026-09-01. The office executes Regionplan 2026: access, primary care, more vårdplatser.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén (läkemedelschef Maria Carlson Brühl). Stewards REKlistan 2026, localises NT-rådet recommendations, maintains the regionala medicinska riktlinjer.
Represents Västra in NT-rådet; chairs VGR's beredningsgrupp läkemedel.
VGR's HSD also holds the Västra seat on NSG Läkemedel, so national clinical-strategy signalling sits with the same person who runs regional delivery.

Region Östergötland.focus: Chairs the M-led hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden. The 2026 healthcare budget (≈17.35 bn SEK) puts money behind nära vård (+20 mnkr to primärvård), shorter waiting lists (15 mnkr; about 16,000 waiting) and a new styr- och ersättningsmodell for klinikläkemedel from 2026 (+50 mnkr).

In post since 2025-06-01 (after Annica Öhrn); cardiologist and former chefläkare with a Sydöstra-region background. Runs Universitetssjukhuset i Linköping tertiary care and the new klinikläkemedel reimbursement model.

Regiondirektör since 2023-10-01 with a long Östergötland operations record. Executes the Regionplan as the region returns to economic balance, across its three hospitals (Linköping, Norrköping, Motala).
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén (LKÖ). Maintains the regional Rekommenderade läkemedel list through therapy-area expert groups and localises NT-rådet recommendations into Östergötland practice.
Jönköping cardiologist; held the NT-rådet acting chair for Sydöstra through 2026-06-30. The national chair passed to Margareta Holmström (Linköpings universitet / US Linköping) on 2026-07-01.
Holds the Sydöstra seat on NSG Läkemedel, setting clinical-care priorities across Östergötland, Jönköping and Kalmar.

Region Jönköpings län.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden; priorities centre on kostnadseffektiv vård within a healthcare budget of roughly 15 bn SEK.
Long-serving HSD, retiring during 2026; successor not yet named publicly. Continuity of the klinikläkemedel pathway is the open question.
Region operations; Jönköping's established improvement culture and budget discipline.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén and is also the Sydöstra ordinary member of NT-rådet (one person, two seats), linking regional formulary stewardship to national managed introduction.
Jönköping cardiologist; was NT-rådet acting chair through 2026-06-30. The national chair passed to Margareta Holmström on 2026-07-01.
Holds the Sydöstra seat on NSG Läkemedel; coordinates across Östergötland, Jönköping and Kalmar.

Region Halland.focus: Halland has no single regional HSN ordförande — health-board functions sit with Regionstyrelsen (ordf Mikaela Waltersson, M) and Hälso- och sjukvårdsstyrelsen. Engagement that targets a single Halland HSN ordförande has the wrong adressat.

Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör (in post; appointment announced 2024-12-18). Leads the hälso- och sjukvårdsförvaltning and also holds the Södra seat on NSG Läkemedel, coordinating clinical-care priorities across Skåne, Blekinge, Halland and Kronoberg.
Region operations and Halland's integrated kommun + region närsjukvård model.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén; maintains the regional formulary and localises NT-rådet recommendations.
Sits for Södra in NT-rådet — Skåne, Blekinge, Halland and Kronoberg.
Holds the Södra seat on NSG Läkemedel, leading clinical-care prioritisation across the four Södra regions (Skåne, Blekinge, Halland, Kronoberg).

Region Västerbotten.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden; the central question is access equity across a large, sparsely populated geography — rural access and telemedicine-supported specialty care.
Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör (in post since 2025-10-01) and national chair of NSG Läkemedel — regional delivery and national clinical-strategy signalling sit with the same person.
Region operations; Norrlands universitetssjukhus Umeå hosts the national ATTR reference centre (V30M founder cluster) and anchors SVR-level coordination.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén; leads Norrlandstinget formulary harmonisation across the four northern regions.
Norrbotten apotekare; sits for Norra in NT-rådet and is its vice ordförande (the 2026-07-01 change was the chair handover, Mårten Lindström → Margareta Holmström).
Holds the Norra seat and chairs NSG Läkemedel nationally (same person as the region's HSD, in post since 2025-10-01).

Region Uppsala.focus: Uppsala has no single hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnd; the Sjukhusstyrelsen governs hospital care — Akademiska sjukhuset and Lasarettet i Enköping — covering specialised care, capacity and waiting times.
The Vårdstyrelsen governs primary care, nära vård and dental care, including the region's own and contracted providers, and stewards the shift to care closer to the patient.
Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; coordinates clinical operations, care quality, access and kunskapsstyrning across the region's hospitals and primary care.
Regiondirektör; leads the koncernledning and implements the adopted Regionplan och budget across the region's operations.

Nephrologist; chairs Läkemedelskommittén and maintains the regional rekommenderade läkemedel. Also the Mellansverige representative to NT-rådet, so one person spans regional formulary and national managed introduction.

Region Uppsala.role: NSG rep · Magnus A Johansson (Sörmland HSD)
Region Uppsala.focus: Region Sörmland's HSD; holds the Mellansverige seat on NSG Läkemedel and sets clinical-care priorities across the seven Mellansverige regions.

Region Kalmar.role: Beredningsordf hälso- och sjukvård · Mattias Adolfson (S)
Region Kalmar.focus: Region Kalmar län has no standalone hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnd; healthcare politics sit in a beredning under regionfullmäktige (chair Adolfson; vice Jimmy Loord, KD, and Emmy Ahlstedt, C) that prepares and monitors, while executive mandate rests with regionstyrelsen (ordf Angelica Katsanidou, S).
Leads the hälso- och sjukvårdsförvaltning and its three hospitals (incl. Länssjukhuset i Kalmar); also holds the Sydöstra seat on NSG Läkemedel.

Regiondirektör since 2026-05-01 (after Ingeborg Eriksson). Regionplan 2026–2028 is budgeted to a +332 mnkr result for 2026, with primary care, imaging capacity (PET/CT, MR) and a single point of access for child and youth mental health among the named priorities.
Distriktsläkare; chairs Läkemedelskommittén and issues the region's Rekommenderade läkemedel (2026) and prescriber guidance.
Represents Sydöstra in NT-rådet; held the acting chair through 2026-06-30, after which it passed to Margareta Holmström on 2026-07-01.
Holds the Sydöstra seat on NSG Läkemedel (the same person as the region's HSD); coordinates across Östergötland, Jönköping and Kalmar.

Region Norrbotten.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden (vice Caroline Svensson, C); steers the nämnd's remit over omställning till nära vård, primärvård and tandvård across a large, sparsely populated geography.

Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör (appointed 2025-11-19, in post 2026, after acting Maria Joelsson); physician and microbiology docent, previously a Läkemedelsverket director for drug supply. Leads the healthcare administration and is föredragande in HSN.
Regiondirektör; accountable for the reviderad budget 2026 and the region's economic restructuring (negative balanskravsresultat across the period), with delivery anchored at Sunderby sjukhus.
Informationsapotekare; chairs Norrbottens Läkemedelskommitté, supporting prescribers with education and the region's rekommenderade läkemedel / terapirekommendationer, oriented to primary care.
Norrbotten apotekare; sits for Norra in NT-rådet and is its vice ordförande (the 2026-07-01 change was the chair handover, Mårten Lindström → Margareta Holmström).
Region Västerbotten's HSD holds the Norra seat and chairs NSG Läkemedel nationally (HSD in post since 2025-10-01).

Region Gotland.focus: Chairs Gotland’s hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnd (2:e vice Eva Ahlin, C); steers access, nära vård and the Visby lasarett and primary-care investment priorities in a single-hospital island setting.

Förvaltningschef and hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; leads healthcare delivery and the coming decade’s Visby lasarett and primary-care investments. A handover to incoming HSD Anna Nergårdh is expected 2026-08-10.
Regiondirektör of the combined kommun + region; executes Regionplan 2026 from a weakened economic position. Gotland has the highest healthcare cost per capita in the country.
Överläkare (infektion/lungmedicin); chairs Läkemedelskommittén, which issues the recommended-medicines list and prescriber guidance free of commercial interests.
Stockholm klinisk farmakologi; sits for Stockholm-Gotland in NT-rådet.
Holds the Stockholm-Gotland seat on NSG Läkemedel, setting clinical-care priorities across Stockholm and Gotland.

Region Sörmland.focus: Sörmland has no separate hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnd; healthcare sits with the regionstyrelse (ordf Christoffer Öqvist, M), with Lars Lundqvist (KD) as regionråd for hälso- och sjukvård. 2026 priorities centre on shorter waiting lists and nära vård.

Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör (a different person from the regiondirektör of the same surname); leads the healthcare delivery area across Mälarsjukhuset Eskilstuna, Nyköping and Kullbergska Katrineholm.
Regiondirektör since 2023 (nurse by background, former Västernorrland HSD); steers the 2026 budget under cost-reduction pressure, including a workforce-reduction requirement.
Överläkare (endocrinology) and head of Läkemedelscentrum; chairs Läkemedelskommittén and its expert groups, maintaining the regional rekommenderade läkemedel.
Uppsala nephrologist and the region's LK ordf; represents Mellansverige in NT-rådet.

Region Sörmland.focus: Sörmland’s own HSD holds the Mellansverige seat on NSG Läkemedel, coordinating across the seven Mellansverige regions.

Region Västmanland.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden in the M/KD/L majority; access and primary-care reform — egen läkare continuity, evening-open vårdcentraler and curbing improper nätläkare reimbursement.
Acting hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör since Lars Almroth left for Socialstyrelsen (end of May 2026); steers the HoS2029 omställning, the vårdplats situation and cost control. Permanent recruit pending.
Regiondirektör; executes Regionplan 2026–2028 with a focus on ekonomi i balans and a region-wide cost-restraint program.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén (sjukvårdsfarmaci); maintains Basläkemedel 2026 / rekommenderade läkemedel and oversees läkemedelsförsörjning.
Uppsala nephrologist and the region's LK ordf; represents Mellansverige in NT-rådet.

Region Västmanland.focus: Region Sörmland's hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; holds the Mellansverige seat on NSG Läkemedel and sets clinical-care priorities across the seven Mellansverige regions.

Region Örebro län.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden; 2025–26 work includes the nära vård genomförandeplan for the western county district and a healthcare-administration utvecklingsplan.

Acting hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör since Jonas Claesson left for VGR (Feb 2026); leads the administration through the transition — access, nära vård, Universitetssjukhuset Örebro. Permanent recruit pending.
Regiondirektör; oversees Regionplan 2026 execution and the healthcare-administration leadership transition.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén and heads Läkemedelscentrum; published Rekommenderade läkemedel 2026–2027 (added chapters on chronic kidney disease and obesity).
Uppsala nephrologist and the region's LK ordf; represents Mellansverige in NT-rådet.

Region Örebro län.focus: Region Sörmland's hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; holds the Mellansverige seat on NSG Läkemedel and sets clinical-care priorities across the seven Mellansverige regions.

Region Dalarna.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden; 2026 work spans access (En väg in for child and youth mental health) and a trygg vårdsommar effort.

Region Dalarna.role: HSD · vakant — tf. direktör (ej namngiven per 2026-06-25)
Region Dalarna.focus: Åsa Dedering left the HSD post on 2026-07-06 after about five years (announced 2026-06-23). An interim director leads pending a permanent appointment — none named as of 2026-06-25. Operational lead for access, nära vård and Falu lasarett.
Regiondirektör; oversees Regionplan 2026 — sustainable finances, reduced reliance on hyrpersonal, patient safety and access.
Chairs Dalarnas läkemedelskommitté (about 20 therapy groups, based at Falu lasarett); maintains the Basläkemedel and terapirekommendationer.
Uppsala nephrologist and the region's LK ordf; represents Mellansverige in NT-rådet.

Region Dalarna.role: NSG rep · Magnus A Johansson (Sörmland HSD)
Region Dalarna.focus: Region Sörmland's hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; holds the Mellansverige seat on NSG Läkemedel and sets clinical-care priorities across the seven Mellansverige regions.

Region Gävleborg.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden; engaged in 2026 on the accountability split between the new region-run hälsocentralsbolag and the nämnd, and on securing provision across the county.
Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; leaving for Region Stockholm in autumn 2026 (successor unnamed). Operational lead for access, nära vård and the two acute hospitals (Gävle, Hudiksvall).
Regiondirektör; also interim VD of the new hälsocentralsbolag (from 2026-02-01) that took over the affected health centres — a central piece of the primary-care restructuring.
Specialist in allmänmedicin; chairs Läkemedelskommittén and signs the regional Rekommenderade läkemedel (2025–2026).
Uppsala nephrologist and the region's LK ordf; represents Mellansverige in NT-rådet.

Region Gävleborg.focus: Region Sörmland's hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; holds the Mellansverige seat on NSG Läkemedel and sets clinical-care priorities across the seven Mellansverige regions.

Region Värmland.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden; 2026 priorities are economy in balance, shorter waiting lists (extra funds to the longest-wait areas) and stronger primary care (vårdcentralernas basuppdrag).
Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör and biträdande regiondirektör; operational lead for the Framtidens hälso- och sjukvård plan and Centralsjukhuset i Karlstad.
Regiondirektör; accountable for the Regionplan 2026 goal of economy in balance.

The Läkemedelskommitté ordförande seat is listed as vacant as of 2026-06-18 (chaired by Malgorzata Antoniewicz through late 2025); the committee continues to issue rekommenderade läkemedel via Läkemedelscentrum.
Uppsala nephrologist and the region's LK ordf; represents Mellansverige in NT-rådet.

Region Värmland.focus: Region Sörmland's hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; holds the Mellansverige seat on NSG Läkemedel and sets clinical-care priorities across the seven Mellansverige regions.

Region Blekinge.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden, which carries the bulk of the region’s deficit while it reorganises into three divisions (Specialist-, Närsjukvårds- and Akut- och service).
Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör (permanent since July 2025); drives the new three-division organisation and the access and savings agenda.
Regiondirektör, made permanent on 2025-12-18 after an extended acting period; oversees the financial recovery and the healthcare reorganisation.
Allmänläkare; chairs the läkemedelskommitté, which issues rekommenderade läkemedel and prescribing guidance (recent focus on diclofenac and opioid prescribing).
Apotekare; sits for Södra in NT-rådet — Skåne, Blekinge, Halland and Kronoberg.
Holds the Södra seat on NSG Läkemedel, leading clinical-care prioritisation across the four Södra regions.

Region Kronoberg.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden in the S+M majority; 2026 priorities include primary-care strengthening, an akutläkarorganisation and shorter waiting lists.
Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; building a stepwise akutläkarorganisation at the two hospitals (Centrallasarettet Växjö, Ljungby lasarett).
Regiondirektör (permanent since 2024-09-20); oversees Regionplan 2026 across healthcare and regional development.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén (also leads the nervous-system therapy group); issues the annual Rekommenderade läkemedel for adults and children.
Apotekare; sits for Södra in NT-rådet — Skåne, Blekinge, Halland and Kronoberg.
Holds the Södra seat on NSG Läkemedel, leading clinical-care prioritisation across the four Södra regions.

Region Västernorrland.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden (majority shifted back to S); oversees the contested sjukhusstrukturförändring across Sundsvall, Örnsköldsvik and Sollefteå, and the nära vård shift.
Acting hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör since 2026-02-24 (about a one-year term); stabilising operations during the hospital-structure reform and leadership turnover. Permanent recruit pending.
Regiondirektör; steers a multi-year budget consolidation (tufft ekonomiskt läge) and the primärvård scale-up.
Chairs Läkemedelskommittén; maintains the regional Mitt läkemedel / rekommenderade läkemedel and the structured introduction of new medicines via Norra.
Norrbotten apotekare; sits for Norra in NT-rådet and is its vice ordförande (the 2026-07-01 change was the chair handover, Mårten Lindström → Margareta Holmström).
Region Västerbotten’s HSD holds the Norra seat and chairs NSG Läkemedel nationally (HSD in post since 2025-10-01).

Region Jämtland Härjedalen.focus: Chairs hälso- och sjukvårdsnämnden under heavy financial strain; the 2026 agenda centres on shorter waiting lists, nära vård (new Centrum för nära vård in Funäsdalen) and access across a sparse geography.
Hälso- och sjukvårdsdirektör; priorities are economic recovery, staffing and summer-cover resilience, and Östersunds sjukhus capacity.
Regiondirektör; 2026 is dominated by closing a structural deficit and workforce strategy in Sweden’s most sparsely populated mainland region.
Läkemedelsansvarig läkare; chairs Läkemedelskommittén and its expert groups, maintaining the regional rekommenderade läkemedel.
Norrbotten apotekare; sits for Norra in NT-rådet and is its vice ordförande (the 2026-07-01 change was the chair handover, Mårten Lindström → Margareta Holmström).
Region Västerbotten’s HSD holds the Norra seat and chairs NSG Läkemedel nationally (HSD in post since 2025-10-01).
